title: Clamp safety grounding lead to enclosure busbar before pulling ceramic fuse carrier
instruction: Remove the ceramic fuse carrier from the distribution panel and place it in the parts tray.
context: Electricians (BLS SOC 47-2111; 762,600 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023) and Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Powerhouse and Substation (SOC 49-2095; 23,400 US jobs) service commercial air conditioning disconnect boxes and distribution panels (such as Eaton/Square D 60A fused pull-out disconnects, ~$35 off-the-shelf). Under OSHA 1910.269(n) and NFPA 70E §120.5 personal protective grounding mandates, de-energized distribution busbars can carry hazardous induced capacitive charge or backfeed voltage. Before withdrawing the high-voltage ceramic fuse carrier from its spring-clip receiver, the technician must attach a spring-loaded bronze grounding clamp jaw onto the exposed copper ground busbar tab. Attempting to pull the fuse without equipotential grounding trips the safety interlock (immediate 0.0 fail). After grounding, the worker extracts the fuse carrier and places it into the parts tray.
setup: Commercial fused disconnect enclosure centered at x 22 cm, y 0 cm, with an open steel door, a 6 mm thick vertical copper ground busbar tab at x 22 cm, y -6 cm, and a central ceramic pull-out fuse carrier seated in spring clips. A bronze grounding clamp with insulated grip sits at x 18 cm, y -18 cm. A molded parts safety tray sits at x 22 cm, y +18 cm.
scoring: Score 1.0 when grounding clamp jaw is clamped onto the copper busbar tab (dr <= 15 mm, dz <= 15 mm), fuse carrier extracted from receiver clips and placed into the safety tray (dr <= 30 mm, dz <= 20 mm), both hands retracted clear >= 50 mm, and held stationary for 1.0 s. Partial: 0.50 grounding clamp attached to busbar; 0.25 grounding clamp lifted. Fail (0.0): pulling fuse before clamp is attached, tripping interlock, or dropping parts.
reset_notes: Place disconnect enclosure at x 0.22 m, y 0.00 m with door open. Place grounding clamp at x 0.18 m, y -0.18 m. Place safety parts tray at x 0.22 m, y +0.18 m.
fidelity: Commercial NEMA 3R 60A disconnect box (210x130x90 mm steel enclosure, 1.2 kg) with 6 mm copper busbar tab. Heavy bronze spring grounding clamp (0.35 kg, 18 N jaw spring). Ceramic pull-out fuse carrier (0.16 kg, 20 N clip retention force). Authentic rigid contact physics, zero deformable cables, zero proximity catch welds.
